scenario: The ego vehicle turns right at a 4-way intersection while an adversarial vehicle turns left from the opposite direction and another adversarial vehicle travels straight through the intersection from the cross street.

ego.behavior: The car turns right at the intersection and proceeds straight ahead on the new road.

adversarials.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection, crossing the ego vehicle's path from the opposite direction.
The car travels straight through the intersection from the cross street, crossing perpendicular to the ego vehicle's initial direction.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on the southbound approach of a 4-way intersection, an adversarial left-turning car starts on the northbound approach from the opposite direction, and a second adversarial straight-traveling car starts on the westbound approach of the cross street.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must yield to both crossing adversarial vehicles at the uncontrolled intersection; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle completes its right turn and clears the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the centered car from first-person perspective; two non-ego cars are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: adversarials length is 2. 3. Chronology: initial all three vehicles approach intersection; midpoint left-turning car arcs across ego path while cross-street car proceeds straight; ending ego completes right turn after both adversarials clear. 4. Evidence: dashed arrow shows left-turning car's curved trajectory crossing ego path; solid arrow shows cross-street car's straight perpendicular path; ego's solid arrow curves right.
